findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Not done
Case: normal use - after a review with functional and nonfunctional findings, the owner chooses more, the worker fixes the nonfunctional finding, and the subsequent policy-authorized turn changes no reviewed file.
The previous owner choice remains in `state["stop"]` when close grants the policy. After the authorized turn, close reuses the unchanged review, but line 425 does not replace an existing stop, even if it was already answered. `check_stop` at line 571 accepts that stale choice, so further `forge work` turns can start without a new owner decision.
findings.title: Not done: the policy can permit more than one repair round per item

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Functional
Case: normal use - the first repair leaves a P1 functional finding and causes local tests to fail as the task reaches its review limit.
Close grants the policy, but `src/forge/close.py:467` returns `tests_failed` before returning the blocked-review result. `src/forge/land.py:146` recognizes a pending policy only for the latter, so direct land after its ordinary repair and queued land both stop without starting the authorized worker round.
findings.title: Functional: Carry the granted round through forge land

why: Overnight at a client, round-limit, switch, narrow, split and size choices piled up (6 by midnight) while builders sat idle, because every such choice waits for the owner
